title: Cadmies Pipeline Philosophy
definition: A cohesive approach to data processing and knowledge extraction, emphasizing rigor, data cleanliness, and the interconnected nature of every phase.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A set of rules for organizing and analyzing data in a way that ensures accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A philosophical framework for data processing that prioritizes scientific rigor, data cleanliness, and the interconnection of each phase of the pipeline.
difficulty_levels.expert: A unique approach to data processing and knowledge extraction that emphasizes the importance of a well-structured, efficient, and reliable pipeline, as well as the interdependence of each phase.

extra_fields.insight: The philosophical underpinnings of the CADMIES pipeline, which prioritize scientific rigor, data cleanliness, and the interconnected nature of each phase.
